LESSON: KUSOMA 11.2.1 KUSOMA KWA MAPANA MATINI YA KUJICHAGULIA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: MAJUKUMU YA WATOTO Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Uji
Topic 11.2: Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza ujumbe wa matini ya kujichagulia
2. kutambua msamiati uliotumiwa katika matini ya kujichagulia
3. kutumia ipasavyo msamiati aliosoma katika matini ya kujichagulia

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza ujumbe wa matini ya kujichagulia
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza ujumbe wa matini ya kujichagulia. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua msamiati uliotumiwa katika matini ya kujichagulia
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua msamiati uliotumiwa katika matini ya kujichagulia. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia ipasavyo msamiati aliosoma katika matini ya kujichagulia
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia ipasavyo msamiati aliosoma katika matini ya kujichagulia. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.
4. Show that you can: kueleza ujumbe wa matini ya kujichagulia

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza ujumbe wa matini ya kujichagulia
2. kutambua msamiati uliotumiwa katika matini ya kujichagulia
3. kutumia ipasavyo msamiati aliosoma katika matini ya kujichagulia

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
